main_text.p: post Legem sirempsem de Mysteriis: [illegible, ~40 letters: Greek, opening words of a Greek quotation]. Vlpianus: [illegible, ~30 letters: Greek]

Atheniensibus eximie cultus est Apollo, eique passim tota urbe ædes sacræ constitutæ,& festa in eius honorem instituta: sed Deliorum maxime toto tempore sacris operata Urbs noluit,quenquam capitis damnatum, dum Delum eunt redeuntque Theori, pœnas [?]lare:
[illegible, ~45 letters: Greek, Δημοσία ... ] | Deliorum festos dies,dum Delum itur,re-ditur,damnatorum supplicijs ne funestato.

Meminerunt huius Legis Xenophon ac Plato, qui obseruant Socratem triginta dies in carcere & in expectatione mortis exegisse post damnationem, quia Delia festa interuenerunt. Verba Xenophontis sunt [illegible, ~60 letters: Greek]. Lib.IV. [illegible, ~50 letters: Greek]. Plato Phaedone: [illegible, ~120 letters: Greek].

Quod hic obseruant Atheniensis, ne funestent damnatorum pœnis Deliorum dies festos atque lætos, honōri[?] Apollinis id datũ, quem non tantum Græci,sed etiam ultimarum terrarum homines in Græcia coluerunt,primitiasque obtulerunt, quod vel Abaridis testatur historia, & Tyriorum exemplum probat apud Euripidem Phœnissis,cuius versus è persona Chori merentur hic expendi, multum enim conferent ad præferendã lucem iis quæ de Tyriorum coloniis in Africa vicinisque Insulis dicuntur:

Male ista veteres Græci Magistri interpretantur de Tyro; quasi Tyrus ab Agenoris nepotibus vi fuerit capta, & delecta puellarum, quæ in seruitutem redactæ fuerant, manus Apollini Delphico consecrata: sed Tyrus semper fuit in potestate Regum Phœniciæ totius tractus Metropolis : Adde quod

page.notes: Greek passages are only partly legible in this scan; they are marked as illegible rather than guessed. The Greek line beginning "ἀχροδίνια" and the line "Γαριασοῦ" are uncertain, with [?] marks on the doubtful letters. "[?]lare" after "pœnas" is not clear enough to read. "honōri[?]" is a doubtful reading. The verse lines in the list are indented and are set as separate lines. The Latin running text has been normalised for long s and u/v only.
